packageRules.description: Group pnpm workspace dependency bumps (minor/patch) into one PR; majors stay individual for review.
GitHub Actions: group, and auto-merge digest-only bumps (an already-pinned SHA moving to a newer SHA of the same tag is safe); version-tag bumps still need review.
Digest bumps of already-pinned GitHub Actions are inert (no behavior change) and safe to auto-merge.
Docker base images (Dockerfiles + docker-compose dev env): grouped, digest-pinned, never auto-merged (can break apt-get pins / runtime behavior).

customManagers.description: Helm values.yaml doesn't use a Chart.yaml dependencies: block — postgresql.image/minio.image are hand-templated strings Renovate's built-in helm managers don't scan.
